title: pendingPhUSD() and pendingStable() revert (underflow) for users who used pauseWithdraw, breaking dashboards / integrators
rootCause: Both view helpers compute `(userDetails.amount * _accX) / PRECISION - userDetails.XDebt`. They share the same underflow path as `_claimRewards` (see CODE-002): after a `pauseWithdraw` reduces `user.amount` while leaving the debt anchored to the pre-pauseWithdraw amount and an earlier `accX` checkpoint, the subtraction underflows and the view reverts on Solidity 0.8 checked arithmetic.
impact: Front-ends, indexers, and on-chain integrators (e.g. zap helpers, aggregator contracts, governance dashboards) that call `pendingPhUSD(user)` / `pendingStable(user)` will revert for affected users. The view-revert masks the underlying mutating-path failure (CODE-002), making the bug hard to diagnose by ops without on-chain experimentation. View-DoS is independent of and additional to the mutating-path DoS.
attackVector: No attacker. Same passive sequence as CODE-002: any user who has used `pauseWithdraw(part)` and then reads their pending balance will trigger the revert.
steps: Reproduce CODE-002 sequence up to and including pauseWithdraw(part).
Frontend calls pendingPhUSD(user) -- reverts with Panic 0x11.
Frontend calls pendingStable(user) -- reverts with Panic 0x11.
remediation: Clamp the subtraction in both view helpers: `return X >= Y ? X - Y : 0;`. This matches the user's intuition (no pending after partial pauseWithdraw forfeiture) and is consistent with the proposed remediation of CODE-002.
profileReference: Profile §4.4 pendingPhUSD/pendingStable explicitly notes 'Reverts (underflow) for the same edge case as _claimRewards'.
